limits: These Cargo baselines precede the registry web Bazel conversion. They do not establish Bazel feature, compiler, editor, packaging, or runtime parity.
The native library executes 18 unit cases and one doctest. The native binary has no test cases.

The browser baseline compiles the actual aos-registry-spa binary with the workspace release profile and processes it with the source-built AOS wasm-bindgen CLI. It does not execute the SPA in a browser.
The retained dist files use stable development names. Content-addressed asset naming, the generated registry HTML loader, and deployment packaging remain separate qualification work.
Both builds use AOS source-built tools and an offline vendor tree inside Nix sandboxes, with no shared compiler cache mount requested.
